render-30th-pdf-page-to-png-150-dpi.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it has at least 30 pages, renders the 30th page to a PNG image using a 150 DPI resolution, and saves the result to disk.

generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSLT with Aspose.Pdf
generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt.description: Demonstrates binding an XML file with an XSLT stylesheet using Aspose.Pdf's Document constructor and saving the output as a PDF.

bind-xml-data-to-pdf-using-xsd.title: Bind XML Data to PDF Using XSD Schema
bind-xml-data-to-pdf-using-xsd.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, validating XML against an XSD schema, binding the XML data to the PDF, and saving the resulting document.

bind-custom-pageinfo-xml-to-pdf.title: Bind Custom PageInfo XML to a PDF and Save
bind-custom-pageinfo-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a custom PageInfo XML definition, bind it to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and save the resulting document.

add-html-fragment-to-pdf.title: Insert HTML Fragment into PDF via XML and Direct API
add-html-fragment-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating an HtmlFragment element with CDATA‑wrapped HTML, inserting it into the PDF's exported XML, and adding the same HTML directly to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-centered-table-pdf.title: Create Centered Table with Header in PDF
create-centered-table-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to build a table with header and data rows, set alignment and column widths, and save it as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-reference-via-xml-binding.title: Add Image Reference via XML Binding to PDF
add-image-reference-via-xml-binding.description: Shows how to export a tagged PDF to XML, insert an <Image File="..."/> element, bind the modified XML back to the PDF, and save the updated document.

insert-graph-element-into-pdf.description: Shows how to export a PDF to XML, inject a <Graph> element containing <Circle> and <GraphInfo> nodes, bind the modified XML back to the document, and save the updated PDF.

bind-image-to-xml-pdf-template.title: Bind Image to XML PDF Template and Save
bind-image-to-xml-pdf-template.description: Loads an XML template as a PDF document, finds an image form field by its Id, sets the field's source file, and saves the resulting PDF.

combine-html-table-image-pdf.title: Combine HTML Fragment, Table, and Image into a PDF
combine-html-table-image-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add an HTML fragment, a formatted table, and an external image to a single PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and then save the document.

create-landscape-pdf-xml-binding.title: Create Landscape PDF via XML Binding
create-landscape-pdf-xml-binding.description: Shows how to generate a PDF in landscape orientation by defining a PageInfo with IsLandscape='true' in an XML string and binding that XML to an Aspose.Pdf Document.

set-custom-page-margins.title: Set Custom Page Margins in PDF
set-custom-page-margins.description: Creates a PDF, adds a page, applies 1‑inch margins using MarginInfo, and writes a sample paragraph to demonstrate the margin settings.

create-pdf-with-custom-page-size.title: Create PDF with Custom Page Size
create-pdf-with-custom-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to set custom width and height for a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's PageInfo and add a simple text fragment.

set-multiple-textsegments-dynamically-be.title: Set Multiple TextSegment Values Dynamically Before XML Binding

bind-xml-data-to-pdf-after-placeholder-r.title: Bind XML Data to PDF After Placeholder Replacement

add-html-cdata-fragment-to-xml-for-pdf-b.title: Add HTML CDATA Fragment to XML and Bind to PDF

add-table-with-alignment-to-pdf.title: Add Table with Alignment to PDF via XML Binding
add-table-with-alignment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to programmatically insert a Table element with a custom Alignment attribute into an XML template and bind the modified XML to generate a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-path-to-xml-for-pdf-binding.title: Add Image Path to XML for PDF Data Binding
add-image-path-to-xml-for-pdf-binding.description: Demonstrates how to insert an image file path into an XML document at runtime and bind the modified XML to a PDF template using Aspose.Pdf, resulting in a PDF with the image placeholder populated.

add-graph-element-embed-xml-into-pdf.title: Add Graph Element to XML and Embed into PDF
add-graph-element-embed-xml-into-pdf.description: Shows how to programmatically insert a <Graph> element with <Circle> and <GraphInfo> into an XML file, embed the modified XML into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and save the updated document.

set-pdf-pages-landscape-xml.title: Set PDF Pages to Landscape via XML Binding
set-pdf-pages-landscape-xml.description: Demonstrates exporting a PDF to XML, changing the PageInfo.IsLandscape attribute, binding the modified XML back to the document, and saving the updated PDF.

set-custom-page-margins-xml.title: Set Custom Page Margins via XML in PDF
set-custom-page-margins-xml.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically define custom page margins using an XML snippet, bind it to a PDF document, and save the updated file with Aspose.Pdf.

set-custom-page-size-via-pageinfo-xml.title: Set Custom Page Size via PageInfo XML in PDF

update-textsegment-xml-and-bind.title: Update TextSegment in PDF XML and Bind to Template

modify-xml-pageinfo-bind-to-pdf.title: Modify XML PageInfo and Bind to PDF

modify-pdf-page-size-via-xml.title: Modify PDF Page Size via XML and Generate PDF
modify-pdf-page-size-via-xml.description: Shows how to load an XML file describing a PDF, change the PageInfo Width and Height attributes, bind the modified XML to an Aspose.Pdf Document, and save the result as a PDF.
